checkedAlternates.risk: Aflatoxin is produced by Aspergillus mold.
checkedAlternates.resolution: In HACCP, pre-formed mycotoxins like aflatoxin are classified as chemical hazards (group-3), not live infectious biological pathogens (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Allergens trigger an immune reaction to specific proteins.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Regulatory HACCP treats major food allergens as a distinct allergen control category (group-1), separate from toxic chemical contaminants (group-3).
